title: Farz-e-Ain vs Farz-e-Kifayah: Farq Kya Hai?
script: Ye hai Farz-e-Ain aur ye hai Farz-e-Kifayah, aakhir isme farq kya hai? Ek har musalman par shakhsi farz hai... Jabke doosra chand logon ke karne se ada ho jata hai! Farz-e-Ain har ek musalman par alag se lazmi hai jaise paanch waqt ki salah. Lekin Farz-e-Kifayah ijtima'i zimmedari hai jaise Namaz-e-Janazah jo chand log ada karein to sabki taraf se ada ho jati hai. Farz-e-Ain shakhsi zimmedari hai, jabke Farz-e-Kifayah ijtimai. Mazeed videos ke liye follow karein.
